name: Signal lantern
notes: 1775 Old North Church pierced-tin lantern. Origin base center. Joints flame 0...1 (hinge about Y, switch follower at 0.5, lights candle flame, glowing punches and point light) and door 0...100 degrees. States lit, unlit, lit-open.
parts: cylindrical pierced tin body with punched star and diamond pattern
domed conical cap with vent chimney and ring finial
style: Colonial pierced tin lantern, tarnished tin, hand-punched stars and diamonds, warm candle glow through the holes.
summary: 1775 pierced-tin signal lantern, 34 cm: punched star and diamond body, conical cap with chimney, hinged door, wire bail and a candle that glows through the holes.
